注意力就够了：Transformer 诞生: Attention is all you need: the Transformer is born
一篇谷歌论文，换掉了语言模型的“发动机”。: One Google paper replaced the “engine” of language models.
2017 年 6 月 12 日，arXiv；同年在 NeurIPS 会议发表: 12 June 2017 on arXiv; presented at NeurIPS the same year
Ashish Vaswani、Noam Shazeer、Niki Parmar、: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin
自注意力：句子里的每个词同时“看”其他所有词: Self-attention: every word in a sentence “looks at” every other word at once
GPT 里的 T，就是 Transformer: The T in GPT stands for Transformer
2017 年 6 月，谷歌的八位作者在 arXiv 发表论文《Attention: In June 2017, eight Google authors published “Attention Is All You Need” on arXiv. It proposed a model architecture called the Transformer: instead of reading word by word in order, every word in a sentence “looks at” all the others at once and works out which words relate most closely. This step is called “self-attention”.
论文的实验做的是机器翻译。在英语译德语、英语译法语两项测试上，它超过了当时最好的: The paper's experiments were on machine translation. On English-to-German and English-to-French benchmarks it beat the best results of the time, and trained in far less time.
在这之前，主流的语言模型（循环神经网络）必须按顺序处理文字，很难同时算，句子一长: Before this, mainstream language models (recurrent neural networks) had to process text in order, which was hard to parallelise, and in long sentences the early information faded. The Transformer computes a whole passage at once, which could soak up ever more GPU compute.
之后的 GPT、BERT、Claude、Gemini、Grok，底层几乎都是这套: GPT, BERT, Claude, Gemini and Grok that followed are nearly all built on this architecture. Calling it the common ancestor of today's large models is no exaggeration.
记住两件事就够用：第一，模型读你的话是“整段一起看、找关系”，所以把要求、材料、: Two things are enough to remember. First, the model reads your words by looking at the whole passage and finding relationships, so keeping instructions, material and examples clearly separate helps it find the right ones. Second, there's a limit to how much it can see at once (the “context window”); anything beyond it, it can't see.
论文只解决翻译，作者没有预言聊天机器人。注意力的计算量随文字长度成倍增长，长文本: The paper only tackled translation; the authors didn't predict chatbots. Attention's computation grows with the square of text length, so long texts have always been hard, and much later research has tried to cut that cost.
先读万卷书：GPT-1 与 BERT: Read ten thousand books first: GPT-1 and BERT
先用海量文字“预训练”，再学具体任务，成了新套路。: “Pre-train” on huge amounts of text, then learn specific tasks: a new playbook.
2018 年 6 月，OpenAI；在大量书籍文本上预训练，再微调: June 2018, OpenAI; pre-trained on a large body of book text, then fine-tuned
2018 年 10 月，谷歌；同时看一个词左右两边的上下文: October 2018, Google; looks at the context on both sides of a word at once
GPT 往后猜下一个词，擅长生成；BERT 做填空，擅长理解和搜索: GPT guesses the next word and is good at generating; BERT fills in blanks and is good at understanding and search
2018 年 6 月，OpenAI 发布 GPT（后来被叫作 GPT-1）：用: In June 2018, OpenAI released GPT (later called GPT-1): a Transformer first trained on a large body of book text to learn language itself, then lightly adjusted for specific tasks.
同年 10 月，谷歌发布 BERT。它也先预训练，但会同时看一个词左右两边的文字: That October, Google released BERT. It was also pre-trained, but looked at the text on both sides of a word at once. It broke records by wide margins on a range of reading comprehension and classification benchmarks, and was soon built into Google Search.
以前几乎每个任务都要从零训练一个模型，还要准备大量人工标注的数据。预训练把“学语: Before, almost every task meant training a model from scratch on lots of hand-labelled data. Pre-training separated “learning language” from “learning the task”: read enough text first, and a task can be learned from a little data.
两条路线也从这里分开。BERT 当时更风光；但后来的聊天模型，走的都是 GPT: The two paths split here. BERT was the star at the time, but the chat models that came later all followed GPT's generative path of “keep writing what comes next”.
今天的大模型都是“先读万卷书，再学规矩”。它知道的东西来自训练时读过的文字，所以: Today's large models all “read ten thousand books first, then learn the rules”. What they know comes from the text they read in training, so their knowledge has a cut-off date. To ask about recent events, either give it the material or let it search the web.
模型从文字里学到的不只是知识，也有偏见和错误。读得越多，越难说清它到底学到了什么: Models learn not only knowledge from text, but also its biases and errors. The more they read, the harder it is to say what exactly they have learned.
越大越强：规模定律与 GPT-3: Bigger is stronger: scaling laws and GPT-3
模型、数据、算力一起加大，效果按曲线变好。: Grow the model, data and compute together, and results improve along a curve.
2020 年 1 月，Jared Kaplan 等，《Scaling Laws: January 2020, Jared Kaplan et al., “Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models”
少样本学习：在提示里给几个例子，不用再训练: Few-shot learning: give a few examples in the prompt, no retraining needed
2020 年 1 月，OpenAI 的研究者发表“规模定律”论文：把模型参数、训: In January 2020, OpenAI researchers published the “scaling laws” paper: scale up model parameters, training data and compute in proportion, and the model's error falls along a predictable curve.
同年 5 月，OpenAI 发布 GPT-3，有 1750 亿个参数。最让人吃惊: That May, OpenAI released GPT-3, with 175 billion parameters. The most surprising part: with no further training, just a few examples in the prompt, it could translate, answer questions, rewrite text and even write simple code.
规模定律让“砸钱把模型做大”从赌博变成了可以算账的投资。之后几年，各家公司都在抢: Scaling laws turned “spending money to make models bigger” from a gamble into an investment you could calculate. In the years that followed, companies raced to build ever bigger compute centres.
GPT-3 也让“提示词”第一次成为一种本事：怎么描述任务、给什么例子，直接决定: GPT-3 also made prompting a skill for the first time: how you describe the task and which examples you give directly decide how good the result is.
“给例子”到今天仍是最好用的提示技巧之一。想要什么格式、什么语气，直接放一两个样: Giving examples is still one of the most useful prompting techniques today. If you want a certain format or tone, one or two samples work much better than a pile of adjectives.
曲线不会无限往下走：高质量的文字数据快用完了，单纯加大规模的回报在变小。后来各家: The curve won't fall forever: high-quality text data is running out, and the returns from scale alone are shrinking. Later, labs began having models “think a bit longer before answering” (see the 2024 reasoning models). GPT-3 also made things up with a straight face, a habit that still hasn't been fully cured.
会画画的 AI：DALL·E 2、Midjourney、Stable Diffu: AI that paints: DALL·E 2, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion
一句话出一张图，图像生成在几个月里走进大众。: One sentence, one picture: image generation reached the public within months.
2022 年 7 月开放公测，在 Discord 里用一句话出图: Open beta in July 2022: type one sentence in Discord to get a picture
2022 年 8 月公开发布，并放出模型权重: Public release in August 2022, with the model weights
扩散模型：从一张满是噪点的图出发，一步步去噪，朝文字描述还原画面: Diffusion models: start from an image full of noise and remove it step by step, recovering a picture that matches the text
2022 年，文字生成图片在几个月里从实验室走进大众。4 月，OpenAI 发布: In 2022, text-to-image went from the lab to the public in a matter of months. In April OpenAI released DALL·E 2; in July Midjourney opened its public beta; in August Stability AI released Stable Diffusion publicly, including the model itself, so anyone could run it on their own computer.
它们背后主要是“扩散模型”：先给一张满是噪点的图，再一步步去掉噪点，往文字描述的: Behind them are mainly “diffusion models”: start with an image full of noise, then remove the noise step by step, recovering a picture in the direction of the text description.
出图的门槛一下子从专业软件降到了一句话。Stable Diffusion 开放之: The barrier to making images dropped overnight from professional software to a single sentence. After Stable Diffusion opened up, a flood of plug-ins, style models and workflows appeared.
版权争议也随之而来：训练用的图片大多没有经过作者同意，画师和图库公司提起了多起诉: Copyright disputes followed: most training images were used without their creators' consent, and artists and stock image companies filed several lawsuits.
花屿的插画和漫画也是用 AI 绘图工具画的。我们的经验：先定角色设定图（造型、颜: Onbloom Island's illustrations and comic were also made with AI image tools. Our experience: settle the character sheets first (shape, colour, proportions), then make the panels one at a time, spelling out for each what to draw and where to leave space, just like writing a brief for a person.
训练数据的授权、生成图能不能受版权保护，各国法律还在形成。画面里的手、文字，以及: Licensing of training data, and whether generated images can be copyrighted, are still taking shape in law around the world. Hands, text in the image and consistent characters have always been hard.
Stability AI · Stable Diffusion 公开发布: Stability AI · Stable Diffusion public release
ChatGPT 与 OpenAI：AI 第一次走进每个人的生活: ChatGPT and OpenAI: AI enters everyone's life for the first time
一个对话框，让不写代码的人也用上了大模型。: A chat box put large models in the hands of people who don't write code.
OpenAI，2015 年在旧金山成立，起初是非营利研究机构: OpenAI, founded in San Francisco in 2015, originally a non-profit research lab
基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），2022 年 3 月的 InstructGP: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), published in the March 2022 InstructGPT paper
2022 年 11 月 30 日，OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT，免费开放试: On 30 November 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT, free to try. It was built on the GPT-3.5 series and tuned with reinforcement learning from human feedback: people wrote example answers and ranked different answers, and the model was adjusted toward what people preferred.
据瑞银估算，ChatGPT 上线约两个月，月活跃用户就超过了一亿。: By UBS's estimate, ChatGPT passed 100 million monthly active users about two months after launch.
OpenAI 在 2015 年成立，起初是非营利机构，2019 年设立了“利润有: OpenAI was founded in 2015 as a non-profit. In 2019 it set up a “capped-profit” company, and Microsoft went on to become its largest investor.
GPT-3 的能力早就有了，真正变的是形式：一个对话框，用人话提问，不用写一行代: GPT-3's abilities were already there; what changed was the form: a chat box where you ask in plain language without writing a line of code. AI went from a developer's tool to a mass product, and pushed Google, Meta and others to speed up across the board.
对话的关键是“来回改”。第一版不满意，直接告诉它哪里不对、想要什么样，往往比重新: The key to chatting is going back and forth. If the first version isn't right, telling it directly what's wrong and what you want is often faster than writing a new long prompt.
这种调教方法让模型更礼貌，也更会讨好人，有时会顺着你说错的话往下说。OpenAI: This tuning makes models more polite, and also more eager to please, sometimes going along with something wrong you said. OpenAI's corporate structure, safety commitments and pace of commercialisation have been contested throughout; in November 2023 its CEO was removed by the board and reinstated a few days later.
OpenAI 发布新型号很频繁，最新的型号和能力，以它的官方新闻页为准。: OpenAI releases new models often; for the latest models and capabilities, go by its official news page.

Llama：把大模型交到更多人手里: Llama: large models in more people's hands
Meta 放出模型权重，人人可以下载到自己的机器上跑。: Meta released the model weights, so anyone could download them and run them on their own machine.
2023 年 2 月 24 日，70 亿到 650 亿参数，最初只向研究者开放: 24 February 2023, 7 to 65 billion parameters, initially for researchers only
2023 年 2 月，Meta 发布 LLaMA，最初只给申请通过的研究者使用，: In February 2023, Meta released LLaMA, at first only to approved researchers; before long the model files were circulating online. Llama 2 in July allowed commercial use, and Llama 3 and Llama 4 were also released for download.
“开放权重”的意思是：模型本身可以下载，能放在自己的电脑或服务器上运行、修改、再: “Open weights” means the model itself can be downloaded and run, modified and retrained on your own computer or server. It spurred a wave of open models and tools, so small companies and researchers didn't have to depend entirely on a few big companies' APIs.
要处理敏感资料的团队，可以用开放权重的模型在自己的服务器上跑，资料不出门。代价是: Teams handling sensitive material can run an open-weights model on their own servers, so the data never leaves. The price is maintaining it yourself, and results usually trail the strongest closed models.
开放权重不等于完全开源：训练数据和完整的训练方法没有公开，许可证也有限制。到了: Open weights isn't the same as fully open source: the training data and full training method weren't published, and the licence has restrictions. By 2026, Meta itself had turned to closed models (see Muse Spark).
Claude 与 Anthropic：把安全当成产品的一部分: Claude and Anthropic: safety as part of the product
一家把“让 AI 可靠”当主业的公司，和它的模型 Claude。: A company whose main business is making AI reliable, and its model, Claude.
Anthropic，2021 年成立，注册为公益公司: Anthropic, founded in 2021, registered as a public benefit corporation
宪法式 AI（2022 年 12 月论文）：让模型按一份写明的原则自己检查、修改: Constitutional AI (December 2022 paper): the model checks and revises its own answers against a written set of principles
第一代 Claude，2023 年 3 月 14 日，和 GPT-4 同一天: The first Claude, 14 March 2023, the same day as GPT-4
Claude 3（2024 年 3 月）分出 Haiku、Sonnet、Opus: Claude 3 (March 2024) came in three tiers: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus; Claude Code, for writing code, launched in 2025
Anthropic 在 2021 年成立，创始团队包括从 OpenAI 离开的达: Anthropic was founded in 2021; its founding team included the siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, among others who had left OpenAI. The company describes itself as an AI safety and research company.
2022 年 12 月，它发表“宪法式 AI”论文：给模型一份写明原则的“宪法”: In December 2022 it published the “Constitutional AI” paper: give the model a “constitution” of written principles and have it critique and revise its own answers against them, relying less on large amounts of human rating. The first Claude was released on 14 March 2023.
Anthropic 的特别之处，是把“怎样让模型可靠、可被看懂”当作核心研究：公: What sets Anthropic apart is treating “how to make models reliable and understandable” as core research: it publishes its models' behavioural guidelines, studies what is actually being computed inside the model (interpretability), and has published a “Responsible Scaling Policy” requiring matching safety measures once a model's capabilities reach certain levels.
2025 年起，Claude 在写代码和长时间自主干活上很受开发者欢迎。: From 2025, Claude became popular with developers for writing code and working autonomously for long stretches.
和 Claude 合作，把目标、标准和材料写清楚效果最好。它常会直说“我不确定”: Working with Claude goes best when the goal, criteria and material are written out clearly. It often says plainly “I'm not sure”, or points out contradictions in your material; answers like that are worth stopping to read.
安全优先和商业竞争之间一直有张力：慢了会落后，快了又和自己的主张冲突。外界也在讨: There is constant tension between putting safety first and competing commercially: too slow and you fall behind, too fast and you contradict your own stance. People also debate whether these self-imposed limits can be independently verified. For the latest models, go by the official news page.

Grok 与 xAI：接上实时信息流的 AI: Grok and xAI: AI plugged into a real-time feed
能直接看 X 上的实时帖子，说话也更随意。: It can read live posts on X directly, and talks more casually.
xAI，2023 年由埃隆·马斯克创立: xAI, founded by Elon Musk in 2023
灵感来自小说《银河系漫游指南》；能通过 X 平台获取实时信息: Inspired by the novel “The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy”; gets real-time information through X
Grok 4（2025 年 7 月）；在美国孟菲斯建了大型算力中心 Coloss: Grok 4 (July 2025); built a large compute centre, Colossus, in Memphis, USA
2023 年，埃隆·马斯克创立 xAI。11 月 3 日，xAI 发布 Grok: In 2023, Elon Musk founded xAI. On 3 November, xAI released Grok. The company said it was inspired by “The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy”, answers with some humour and a “rebellious streak”, and gets real-time information through X (formerly Twitter). New versions came quickly, with Grok 4 released in July 2025.
Grok 的不同在两点：一是直接接上 X 的实时帖子，问刚发生的事有优势；二是风: Grok differs in two ways: it connects directly to live posts on X, giving it an edge on things that just happened; and its style is looser, willing to answer some questions others would refuse. That puts it on the other side of the debate over where AI's limits should be drawn.
追热点、看舆论风向时，Grok 搜得快。但社交平台上的消息本来就真假混杂，关键的: For following trending topics and the mood of public opinion, Grok searches fast. But social media mixes truth and falsehood by nature, so check key facts against the original sources.
放得开的风格多次引发争议，出现过冒犯性的输出，xAI 事后做过修正和道歉。模型和: Its loose style has caused controversy several times, including offensive output, after which xAI made corrections and apologised. The boundaries of data and interests between the model, X and Musk's other companies are also a concern. For the latest models, go by the official news page.

Gemini 与 Google DeepMind：从一开始就能看图听声: Gemini and Google DeepMind: seeing and hearing from the start
谷歌把模型放进几十亿人每天在用的产品里。: Google put its model into products billions of people use every day.
2023 年 4 月，DeepMind 和谷歌大脑合并为 Google Deep: April 2023: DeepMind and Google Brain merged into Google DeepMind
2024 年 2 月，一次能读约 100 万个 token: February 2024, reads about a million tokens at once
2025 年 11 月 18 日，进入 Gemini 应用、搜索的 AI 模式和: 18 November 2025, shipped to the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search and developer platforms
2023 年 4 月，谷歌把 DeepMind 和谷歌大脑合并成 Google: In April 2023, Google merged DeepMind and Google Brain into Google DeepMind, led by Demis Hassabis. On 6 December, Gemini 1.0 was released, billed as “natively multimodal”: trained from the start on text, images, audio, video and code together.
2024 年 2 月的 Gemini 1.5 把一次能读的长度拉到约 100 万: Gemini 1.5 in February 2024 stretched what it could read at once to about a million tokens, roughly several books. Gemini 3 was released on 18 November 2025; Google called it its most capable model, and it went live the same day in the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search and developer tools.
